quests.name: Short on Mithril Ore
quests.summary: The banker of Orandale has run out of mithril ore.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 22 mithril ore and nobody in Orandale has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Realtor
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Orandale to the realtor.
intro: This should have gone to the realtor days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the general store keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Food Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the food shop keeper of Orandale and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the food shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The barber sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Orandale Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Orandale Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Orandale Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Bats
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper wants the bat near Orandale thinned out.
intro: The bat beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 14 of them close to Orandale and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Bones
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper of Orandale has run out of bones.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 17 bones and nobody in Orandale has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Archery Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Orandale to the archery shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the archery shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the clothes shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Banker
quests.summary: Call on the banker of Orandale and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the banker and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The food shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Supply Run to Uludale
quests.summary: Gather yew logs for the banker, then carry a shipment to Uludale.
intro: I have an order from Uludale and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 22 yew logs, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the banker in Orandale.
From Orandale? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Orandale and bring back yew logs.
intro: The wilds around Orandale need a firm hand. Start with 14 giant rat outside the walls, then 22 giant spider down in Orandale Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 22 yew logs to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Orandale for the barber.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the food shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The barber asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the archery shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the food shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Orandale Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant rat out of Orandale Sewers and tell the barber.
intro: Orandale Sewers is crawling with giant rat, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 22 of them, then let the barber know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Orandale owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Orandale Sewers is clearer than it was. 22 giant rat fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Uludale (Archery Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Gather maple logs for the archery shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Uludale.
intro: I have an order from Uludale and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 28 maple logs, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the archery shop keeper in Orandale.
From Orandale? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Orandale Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Orandale and Uludale.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Uludale. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 34 giant rat near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the general store keeper in Orandale.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Uludale is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Orandale has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Orandale
quests.summary: Find what rules Orandale Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Rat King.
intro: Something rules Orandale Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the banker what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Orandale is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Rat King.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Rat King is dead. Orandale Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Frostbite Cavern, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Frostbite Cavern has stood against Orandale for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the barber, fight your way through 34 giant spider and end The Broodmother.
Bring 22 raw tuna back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Frostbite Cavern?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Orandale: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.
